note: Hermetic memory corpus for the P3.12 recall eval (written for the eval; not the founder's real memories).

memories.title: Persistence decision
memories.content: Decision: all persistence stays in SQLite; Neon and Postgres were reverted (ADR 026).

memories.title: Dashboard exposure
memories.content: The dashboard binds to 127.0.0.1 and checks Host and Origin; it is never exposed to the network.

memories.title: Who merges
memories.content: The founder merges pull requests; agents open drafts and report; CI is billing-locked so local gates stand in.

memories.title: Hacker News source
memories.content: https://hnrss.org/frontpage is a reliable source for Hacker News front page items.

memories.title: Report format preference
memories.content: The user prefers reports delivered as markdown files with links to sources.

memories.title: Mercury 2 pricing
memories.content: Mercury 2 costs 0.25 dollars per million input tokens and 0.75 per million output tokens.

memories.title: Think Token ids
memories.content: Think Tokens have permanent ids like TT-000001 that are never reused after a delete.

memories.title: Local embeddings
memories.content: Local embeddings use MiniLM L6 and are cached in the data directory after the first download.

memories.title: CodeQL and route lines
memories.content: Keep Express route handler lines unchanged because editing them makes CodeQL re-flag rate limiting alerts.

memories.title: Algorand access
memories.content: Algorand access is read-only; the agent never signs or sends transactions.

memories.title: read hnrss front page and write top5.md
memories.content: Goal: read the hnrss front page and write top5.md. Outcome: completed. Tools: fetch_url, write_file.

memories.title: what pull requests are open
memories.content: Goal: what pull requests are open. Outcome: no open pull requests. Tools: fetch_url.

memories.title: create an empty file and report its size
memories.content: Goal: create an empty file and report its size. Outcome: zero bytes. Tools: write_file.

memories.title: show wallet balance
memories.content: Goal: show the wallet balance. Outcome: balance fetched from the Algorand testnet read-only. Tools: algorand.

memories.title: back up the token database
memories.content: Goal: back up the token database. Outcome: a VACUUM INTO copy was created next to the database.

memories.title: Ollama is optional
memories.content: Ollama is optional; no models are pulled automatically; the local model is named by THINKBOX_LOCAL_MODEL.

memories.title: CI billing lock
memories.content: GitHub Actions jobs fail within seconds when the account billing is locked; nothing is tested by CI then.

memories.title: Live state goes stale
memories.content: Notes about live state such as open pull requests or server status go stale within a day and must be re-checked with a tool.

memories.title: save meeting notes as a markdown file
memories.content: Goal: save meeting notes as a markdown file. Outcome: notes.md written. Tools: write_file.

memories.title: Token lifecycle
memories.content: A lesson moves from candidate to extracted, scored, challenged and then accepted or rejected.
